subject: G-SEM sumstats error -- Zero SNPs matching reference, despite manually checking.

messages.author: 912c054fc1b070f2
messages.subject: G-SEM sumstats error -- Zero SNPs matching reference, despite manually checking.
parts:
Hello, 

I'm pretty familiar w/ LDSC, but my first time using G-SEM.    I'm currently trying to use the sumstats function to process files.      I'm running into an error shown here.   Seems to suggest that there are no matching SNPs.   Further down, I show the file headers and also show manual verification of common RSIDs. 

Any help you can give would be amazing.   I am encountering the same problem both on my home PC and on the Linux server at work.    For some reason I'm not able to past anything in this message, but perhaps in my reply.

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: G-SEM sumstats error -- Zero SNPs matching reference, despite manually checking.
parts:
Hi Daniel, 

I think the issue is that you are passing the w_hm3.noMHC.snplist file as the ref file and not the full 1000G reference file titled reference.1000G.maf.0.005.txt in the box folder where we make materials available. The reason you are getting 1.1 million left when doing the manual merge is that the hm3 file doesn't include MAF information and the sumstats function filters on MAF in the ref file. Let me know if you still have issues!

Best, 
  Andrew
